text:
deploy-bot: starting deploy wave for release v2026.03.1 -> API, runtime, console, router. Deploy window: 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Pin plan: runtime v2.9.3, router v1.14.0, api v3.2.0-canary. Please ack or call blockers.

alice: ack from API. release notes pushed to https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2026.03.1. I'll follow the canary traffic steering.

ben: runtime-oncall here — staging passes for kernel batching changes, but we saw a 30ms p95 bump when sequence len=1024. suggest ramp to 20% for 10m then evaluate.

carla: console team ack but need a migration window. I'll run the console DB migration +12m into the window — if migration takes >5m or any schema errors, we stop + rollback.

alice: traffic steering proposal: 20% -> runtime-v2.9.3 for 10m, if error rate <0.5% and p95 within +50ms then 50% for 15m, then 100%. fallback route: runtime-v2.9.2.

ben: propose automated rollback thresholds: if 5xx rate >2% for 10m OR p95 latency increases by >120ms over baseline for 5m => immediate rollback. also manual abort if regression on quality evals from probe prompts.

carla: please confirm deploybot pin config applied. patch preview:```yaml
pinned_versions:
  runtime: v2.9.3
  router: v1.14.0
  api: v3.2.0-canary
traffic_rules:
  - percent: 20
    to: runtime-v2.9.3
    duration: 600s
fallback: runtime-v2.9.2
```

alice: looks good. I'll attach the canary prompt set to the monitoring dashboard.

runtime-oncall: I'll monitor p95, 5xx, and kv-cache hitrate. tagging @oncall to follow. if anything hits thresholds I'll signal rollback in this thread.

ben: one more note — router config includes a new header-based routing shim. we need console to opt in for the first 20% otherwise route will skip console metrics. carla?

carla: ack, will enable console-opt-in flag at +2m. will post status when flags are live.

alice: minor ask — include a short note in the release notes about known p95 delta for long seqs, so customers are aware. added.

deploy-bot: all acks received (alice, ben, carla, runtime-oncall). scheduling start in 10m. Rollback criteria documented. call out monitors: metrics.dashboard/r2026-03-1, logs.search/r2026-03-1. Proceeding unless a blocker is raised in next 8m. :rocket: 

carla: putting migration job in progress now. will update when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: staging replication done. no further blockers. :thumbsup:

alice: canary traffic begun at 02:10 UTC -> 20% steering to runtime-v2.9.3. monitoring.

runtime-oncall: observed initial p95 +22ms, 5xx steady at 0.08%. kv-hit steady. holding to evaluate for full 10m.

carla: migration completed in 90s, no schema issues. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: 10m canary complete, checks passed per thresholds — bumping to 50% as planned. updating pinned versions in control plane.

alice: bump acked, propagation underway.

ben: keeping watch. will trigger rollback if thresholds breach.

runtime-oncall: monitoring looks green. will keep 30m close watch during 50% window.

carla: console flag at 20% confirmed. all teams green.

deploy-bot: rolling to 100% in 15m if no regressions. final rollback checklist attached to the runbook.
